name: Eva Maydell - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the adoption by Bulgaria of the euro on 1 January 2026
part_text:
Bulgaria wants to replace its currency, the lev, with the euro on 1 January 2026. The European Parliament was asked for its opinion and has approved the plan. It says Bulgaria meets the required economic conditions: low inflation, a small government debt, a stable exchange rate and low interest rates. The Parliament also notes that Bulgaria still needs to do more against money laundering, corruption and to strengthen the rule of law. This is an opinion; the final decision belongs to the Council of the European Union.

- Bulgaria would start using the euro on 1 January 2026, if the Council agrees.
- People and businesses in Bulgaria would switch from the lev to the euro.
- The Council of the European Union now decides, after consulting the European Parliament.
